pages.text: $(l)Swiftwolf's Rending Gale$() is a defensive wind ring. Craft it from Dark Matter, feathers and an Iron Band. It fits the ring curio slot.$(br2)Right-click cycles it between $(l)Off$() and $(l)Shield$(); press $(l)R$() to hurl a lightning bolt.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)The shield repels nearby mobs and projectiles in a radius of about 3 blocks around you.$(li)It drains about 1 EMC per tick while shielding and switches itself off when your EMC runs out.$(li)The old tooltip says "Grants flight". That text is wrong in this version: the ring does $(l)not$() grant any flight.$(li)The $(l)R$() bolt summons lightning on a block or knocks a creature back hard; each shot costs EMC.$(li)On a pedestal it smites nearby non-tamed mobs with lightning on a timer.
